changes.issue: Downloaded older common bundle blocks all later sources
changes.root_cause: Catalog root coverage mismatch raised the same generic ValueError as integrity failures, so the local installer raised environment failure before the built-in and online routes.
changes.fix: A dedicated BundleCoverageUnavailable is handled as source non-match only. The downloaded full bundle remains first; the built-in archive is consulted only for libuci-lua/wpa-cli; non-match or unavailable dependency closure continues to router-online then computer-download routes. Signature, object checksum, cancellation and unsafe/unconfirmed transaction failures still stop. Empty final-route diagnostics no longer display a blank route.

changes.issue: Connection timeout cannot distinguish TCP, SSH banner and authentication stages
changes.fix: Use the documented Paramiko transport_factory on the existing connection to record tcp_connected and ssh_banner_received; preserve host-key and authentication stages; distinguish connection refusal, TCP timeout, no SSH banner, handshake failure, incompatible SSH version, incompatible algorithms and authentication timeout. No extra connection, port scan, firewall change or security-policy relaxation.

references.finding: AuthHandler.wait_for_response raises the transport saved exception directly when inactive; EOF/no saved exception becomes AuthenticationException. ConnectionResetError and plain SSHException may therefore surface after authentication has begun.

ConnectionResetError and related socket disconnect exceptions inherit ConnectionError/OSError; they must be interpreted together with the observed login phase, not treated as proof that TCP was never connected.
Authentication rejection, authentication method restriction, encrypted private key requirements and incompatible peer algorithms are separate exception contracts and retain their dedicated handlers.
